control_flow: followLine: if the line tracker reads below 50 %, curve left; else curve left: both outcomes drive the same curve.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line from the start, through its curves, all the way to the green goal at the line's end, without leaving it.

decision_points.condition: the line tracker's brightness reading is below 50 %

branches.outcome: the floor under the tracker is dark (below 50 %): it curves left, left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %
the floor under the tracker is bright (50 % or more): it curves left, left wheel 20 %, right wheel 50 %, the same
